pages.text: Straw blocks and nests help build a dry sunny habitat beside the living kitchen.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find an iguana on Tropical Islands. Its native shedding interaction establishes trust, then its sunlight cooking produces food. A real cooked output is required.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Explore Spawn Overworld biomes, animals and ambient features. Mod-wide exploration activities beyond item collection.
